ev.q: From 1999 to 2018, death rates for unintentional TBI among persons aged ≤24 years declined across all age groups.
For most of the period, rates were highest for persons aged 20–24 years followed by those aged 15–19, 0–4, and 5–14 years.
TBI-related death rates declined from 3.7 per 100,000 to 1.5 among children aged 0–4 years
according to the National Vital Statistics System
